{"analysis":{"requires_lua":true,"requires_workflow":false,"requires_network":false,"requires_filesystem":false,"requires_side_effects":true,"domain":"general","suggested_name":"notifications.segment_inactive_customers","summary":"List a customer segment and message inactive customers while collecting success and failure ids.","artifact_types":["lua_script"]},"script":{"script":{"format":"luau_body","helpers":"local function send_message(userId: string, name: string): { ok: boolean, id: string?, error: string?, message: string? }
	local text = "Hi " .. name .. ", we miss you!"
	local r = tools.message.send({ user = userId, text = text })
	if r.error then
		return { ok = false, error = r.error, message = r.message }
	end
	return { ok = true, id = r.message_id }
end","body":"local listed = tools.crm.list({ segment = input.segment })
if listed.error then
	return { error = listed.error, message = listed.message }
end

local notified = {}
local failed = {}
local sent_count = 0
local eligible_count = 0

for _, customer in listed.customers do
	if customer.last_seen_days >= input.inactive_days then
		eligible_count += 1
		if sent_count >= 10 then
			return { error = "limit_exceeded", message = "message.send may be called at most 10 times per execution" }
		end

		local result = send_message(customer.id, customer.name)
		if result.ok then
			table.insert(notified, customer.id)
			sent_count += 1
		else
			table.insert(failed, customer.id)
		end
	end
end

return { notified = notified, failed = failed, count = #notified }"},"name":"notify_inactive_segment_customers","description":"List a segment's customers and message inactive customers.","usage_description":"Use this when you need to notify inactive customers in a CRM segment.","tags":["crm","notifications","messaging"],"risk_assessment":"medium","runtime_profile":"transform_only"},"workflow":null}
